title: CPAP Therapy
subtitle: Definitions, symptoms, evaluation, management, safety, and evidence related to CPAP therapy.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports CPAP therapy as an effective and safe treatment for moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea, with numerous randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses confirming sleep quality and cardiovascular benefits. Some emerging evidence investigates CPAP impacts on metabolic health and long-term outcomes that require further study.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
